title: Among patients who had laboratory tests in October 1991 and whose uric acid
question: Among patients who had laboratory tests in October 1991 and whose uric acid levels were outside the normal range for their sex, how many more males than females had creatinine levels above the normal threshold?

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.XCL_058)
   FROM Patient P
   JOIN Laboratory L ON P.XCL_058 = L.XCL_014
   WHERE P.XCL_059 = 'M'
     AND L.XCL_015 BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-31'
     AND L.XCL_022 > 8.0
     AND CAST(L.XCL_056 AS REAL) > 1.5)
  -
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.XCL_058)
   FROM Patient P
   JOIN Laboratory L ON P.XCL_058 = L.XCL_014
   WHERE P.XCL_059 = 'F'
     AND L.XCL_015 BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-31'
     AND L.XCL_022 > 6.5
     AND CAST(L.XCL_056 AS REAL) > 1.5) AS difference

  SELECT DISTINCT P.XCL_058 AS pid, P.XCL_059 AS sex
  FROM Patient P
  JOIN Laboratory L ON P.XCL_058 = L.XCL_014
  WHERE L.XCL_015 LIKE '1991-10-%'
    AND (
      (P.XCL_059 = 'M' AND (L.XCL_020 < 7.0 OR L.XCL_020 > 9.0))
      OR
      (P.XCL_059 = 'F' AND (L.XCL_020 < 6.0 OR L.XCL_020 > 8.5))
    )
